name: Aquatic Form
summary: In Thunder Bluff, a young Horde druid returns to be recognized among the keepers of nature. The druid has proved worthy in Moonglade and taken on the sea lion aspect; now formal recognition brings Aquatic Form.

sections.title: Return of the Sea Lion
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze sends you back to Mulgore after your trials in Moonglade. The Pendant of the Sea Lion bears proof of your balance and dedication across Kalimdor's waters. By carrying it home, you show that you have honored the ancient traditions needed to take an aquatic aspect.

sections.title: Communion with the Waters
sections.body: At Thunder Bluff's heights, you bring the pendant to Turak Runetotem, your mentor. He is pleased that you have honored your ancestors and kept nature in balance. Then Turak teaches you the secret of aquatic form. You can swim beneath rivers and oceans, breathe freely, and find your way through the depths as a sea creature.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This rite completes a young Horde druid's passage. In Thunder Bluff, you present the Pendant of the Sea Lion and learn Aquatic Form.

faq.q: Who do I bring the Pendant of the Sea Lion to?
aliases: where to turn in aquatic form
faq.answer: Bring the Pendant of the Sea Lion to Turak Runetotem, the druid trainer on Thunder Bluff's upper rises in Mulgore.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze sends you back after your aquatic trials in Moonglade are complete.

aliases: can other classes do aquatic form
faq.answer: No. Only druids can complete this rite and advance along their spiritual and magical path toward animal forms.

faq.q: Why does a night elf in Moonglade help a Horde druid?
faq.answer: Moonglade is a neutral sanctuary overseen by the Cenarion Circle. Night elf mentors guide tauren druids in the ancient Cenarion arts, seeking balance in nature without political hostility.

faq.q: What ability does completing this quest grant?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem teaches you Aquatic Form. In this shape, you swim faster and breathe underwater.

angles.text: As a druid, Aquatic Form helps you cross bodies of water with ease and escape predators in the deep.
As a tauren, mastering the beasts of the sea honors your ancestors and strengthens your people's return to druidic ways.
As a member of the Horde, you share the tauren druids' spiritual link to the Cenarion Circle, walking between neutral sanctuaries and tribal capitals.
